mapper.select: select scls_cd , scls_nm from lib_cls lc where mcls_cd = 'c0010' or mcls_cd = 'c0020' or mcls_cd = 'c0030'

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by b.book_id desc) AS idx,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by COUNT(l.loan_id) desc) AS idx,
COALESCE((SELECT f.bk_file_ori_name FROM lib_file_book f WHERE b.book_id = f.book_id), '') AS file_name, b.book_id, title, author, b.ctg_id, c.scls_nm AS ctg_nm, publisher, cheonggu, isbn, MAX(l.loan_id) AS loan_id, COALESCE((SELECT loan_state FROM lib_loans WHERE book_id = b.book_id order by loan_id desc limit 1), 'N') AS loan_state, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM lib_resv WHERE book_id = b.book_id) AS resv_count, (SELECT book_id FROM lib_liked WHERE userid = #{userid} AND book_id = b.book_id) AS liked_id, (SELECT book_id FROM lib_resv WHERE userid = #{userid} AND book_id = b.book_id) AS resv_id FROM lib_books b INNER JOIN lib_cls c ON c.scls_cd = b.ctg_id LEFT JOIN lib_loans l ON l.book_id = b.book_id where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) and ctg_id like CONCAT('%', #{ctgId}, '%')
AND title IS NOT NULL AND title <> '' AND author IS NOT NULL AND author <> '' AND publisher IS NOT NULL AND publisher <> '' AND cheonggu IS NOT NULL AND cheonggu <> ''
GROUP BY b.book_id, title, author, b.ctg_id, c.scls_nm, publisher, cheonggu, isbn
order by book_id desc
order by loan_count desc
limit #{recordCountPerPage} offset #{firstIndex}
